description: This Java source file defines a helper class named ExternalAssetOwnerHelper, which provides methods to interact with external asset owner APIs in the Fineract project. It includes functions for initiating, canceling, retrieving, and searching external asset owner transfer data, as well as managing journal entries and setting financial activities.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to perform operations related to external asset owners, such as transfer requests, cancellations, retrievals, journal entries, searches, and financial activity configurations.

methods.name: initiateTransferByLoanId
methods.description: Initiates a transfer request for a specific loan by loan ID with the given command and request data.

methods.name: cancelTransferByTransferExternalId
methods.description: Cancels an external transfer identified by its external ID.

methods.name: cancelTransferByTransferExternalIdError
methods.description: Attempts to cancel an external transfer and asserts that the operation fails with an HTTP 403 error.

methods.name: retrieveTransferByTransferExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves transfer data for a given external transfer ID.

methods.name: retrieveTransferByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves transfer data associated with a specific external loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveTransfersByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transfers associated with a specific loan ID, with optional pagination.

methods.name: retrieveActiveTransferByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the active transfer data for a specific external loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveActiveTransferByTransferExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the active transfer data for a specific external transfer ID.

methods.name: retrieveActiveTransferByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves the active transfer data for a specific loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesOfTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries associated with a specific transfer ID.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesOfOwner
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries for a specific owner identified by external ID.

methods.name: searchExternalAssetOwnerTransfer
methods.description: Searches external asset owner transfers based on specified search criteria.

methods.name: buildExternalAssetOwnerSearchRequest
methods.description: Constructs a search request object with specified filtering and sorting options.

methods.name: setProperFinancialActivity
methods.description: Configures the financial activity account used for asset transfers, by deleting existing mappings and creating a new one.
